title: Desktop runtime update
items: Updated Harbor’s bundled desktop runtime. No separate runtime installation is needed.
Existing vaults, settings and SSH workflows stay the same.

title: Persistent sessions and quick navigation
items: Keep remote commands running after disconnecting with optional tmux sessions. Enable this per host; tmux must already be installed on the server.
Persistent tabs return after locking and unlocking Harbor. Choose Reconnect to resume your session.
Find hosts, terminals and workspaces with Ctrl+K, or Cmd+K on macOS.
Clearer broadcast controls and more reliable backup identification and background mode.
